scope: Bounded semantic review of five complete public SFC Result fixtures; this is not whole-fix, whole-history, native, target, or dialect acceptance.

coveredRequirements: A PascalCase setup import wins over a same-name lowercase prop when a lowercase component tag is compiled through the separate-template SFC route.
The complete public SFC Result preserves the imported component binding, prop binding, generated module code, and empty diagnostics.
remainingScope: Inline-template, alternate syntax, Vapor, SSR, and runtime behavior remain outside this reviewed fixture scope.

coveredRequirements: Scoped CSS v-bind expressions are rewritten to the same scoped custom-property names emitted by useCssVars.
The complete public SFC Result preserves generated module bytes, populated CSS bytes, bindings, and empty diagnostics.
remainingScope: Vite and Rspack virtual style-module integration, alternate style options, and non-SFC targets remain outside this reviewed fixture scope.

coveredRequirements: A dynamic ref expression inside v-for emits ref_for: true in separate-template SFC output.
The complete public SFC Result preserves the authored TypeScript input, filename, generated module bytes, bindings, and empty diagnostics.
remainingScope: Inline-template, direct DOM entrypoint, alternate syntax, Vapor, SSR, and mounted runtime behavior remain outside this reviewed fixture scope.

coveredRequirements: A computed setup component is unwrapped across ordinary, v-if, v-for, v-once, and dotted component-tag code paths.
The complete public SFC Result preserves generated module bytes, binding metadata, and empty diagnostics.
remainingScope: Direct DOM entrypoint, separate-template output, alternate syntax, Vapor, SSR, and mounted runtime behavior remain outside this reviewed fixture scope.

coveredRequirements: A custom directive on an otherwise-static element with children retains the NEED_PATCH flag and its directive payload.
The complete public SFC Result preserves generated module bytes, binding metadata, and empty diagnostics.
remainingScope: Other patch-flag combinations, alternate syntax, Vapor, SSR, and mounted directive lifecycle behavior remain outside this reviewed fixture scope.
